create_BottleneckTransform: create a BottleneckTransform module with Tx1x1, 1x3x3, 1x1x1 convolution blocks for video recognition
create_BasicTransform: create a BasicTransform module with Tx3x3 and 1x3x3 convolution layers for spatial-temporal feature extraction
create_X3DTransform: create an X3DTransform module with channelwise convolutions and optional SE attention for efficient video models
build_ResBlock: build a ResBlock residual block with skip connections and optional drop path regularization for 3D CNNs
build_ResStage: build a ResStage containing multiple ResBlocks across multiple pathways with optional nonlocal layers
